text.body: <1> prathamo'dhyāyaḥ natvā śivaṃ paramatattvakalāvirūḍhaṃ jñānāmṛtaikacaṭulaṃ paramātmarūpam rāgādirogaśamanaṃ damanaṃ smarasya śaśvatkṣapādhipadharaṃ triguṇātmarūpam 1 ātreyahārītasaṃvādaḥ himavaduttare kūle siddhagandharvasevite śānte mṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ nānā pādapaśobhite 2 tatrasthaṃ tapasā yuktaṃ taruṇādityatejasam śuddhasphaṭikavacchubhraṃ bhūtibhūṣitavigraham 3 jaṭājūṭāṭavīmūle uṣitaṃ śubhrakuṇḍalam ātreyaṃ bahuśiṣyaistu rājitaṃ tapasānvitam 4 papraccha śiṣyo hārītaḥ sarvajñānamidaṃ mahat 5 hārīta uvāca bhavan guṇagaṇādhāra āyurvedavidāṃ vara vinayādavinīto'haṃ pṛcchāmi munipuṅgava 6 kathaṃ rogasamutpattirutpanno jñāyate katham upacāraḥ pracāraśca kathaṃ vā siddhimicchati 7 etatsamyak parijñānaṃ kathayasva mahāmune evaṃ pṛṣṭo mahācāryo hārītena mahātmanā pratyuvāca ṛṣiḥ putraṃ prahasyotphullalocanaḥ 8 ātreya uvāca śṛṇu putra mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada cikitsāśāstrakuśala vaidyavidyāvicakṣaṇa 9 āyurvedamapārantu ślokānāṃ lakṣasaṃkhyayā kathaṃ tasya parijñānaṃ kālenālpena putraka 10 alpāyuṣo'lpavaktāraḥ svalpaśāstraviśāradāḥ alpāvatrāraṇe śaktāḥ kalau jātā ime narāḥ 11 alpaḥ kaliyugaścāyaṃ naropadravakāraṇam kathaṃ putra pravakṣyāmi vistareṇa tavāgamam 12 yasya śravaṇakālo yo yāti cāntañca putraka tasmāccālpatareṇā'pivakṣyāmi śṛṇu sāmpratam 13 caturviṃśasahasraistu mayoktā cādyasaṃhitā tathā dvādaśasāhasrī dvitīyā saṃhitā matā 14 tṛtīyā ṣaṭsahasraistu caturthī tribhireva ca 15 pañcamī dikpañcaśataiḥ proktāḥ pañcātra saṃhitāḥ tasmāccālpatareṇāpi vakṣyāmi śṛṇu putraka 16 yena vijñānamātreṇa gadavedavido bhavet kimatra bahunoktena cālpasāre viśārada 17 yena dharmārthasaukhyaṃ ca taddhi karma samācaret yena saṃjāyate śreyo yena kīrtirmahatsukham 18 tatkarma nitarāṃ sādhyaṃ janānandavidhāyakam 19 ekaṃ śāstraṃ vaidyamadhyātmakaṃ vā saukhyaṃ caikaṃ yatsukhaṃ vā tapo vā vandyaścaiko bhūpatirvā yatirvā ekaṃ karma śreyasaṃ vā yaśo vā 20 bahutaramupacārāt sāramādhāraloke jananamatisukhānāṃ varddhanaṃ śreyasāṃ vā vigatakaluṣabhāvā cojjvalā kīrttimūrttirna khalu kuṭilatāsyāḥ śrūyate lokavṛndaiḥ 21 āyurvedamidaṃ samyak na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit 22 nābhaktāyāpyaśāntāya na mūrkhāya na cādhame śānte deyaṃ na deyaṃ syāt sarvathā nā'dhame'dhane 23 dharmiṣṭho kuhanī vivarjitamanāḥ śāntaḥ śuciḥ śuddhadhīrdhīro'bhīruvivekasārahṛdayo vidyāvilāsojjvalaḥ | prājño rogagaṇapracāranipuṇo'lubdhaḥ sadā toṣadhṛgitthaṃ sarvaguṇākarau nṛpajanaiḥ pūjyaḥ sadā rogavit 24 dṛṣṭvā yathā mṛgapatiṃ gajayūthanāthaḥ saṃśuṣkamānamadabindukapoladhāraḥ tyaktvā vanaṃ vrajati cākulamānasena dṛṣṭvā tathā gadagajo bhiṣajaṃ prayāti 25 yadvattamovṛtamidaṃ bhuvanaṃ mayūkhaiḥ prākāśyamāśu kurute sakalaṃ ravistu tadvatsuvaidya upalabhya rujotināśaṃ śīghraṃ karoti gadinaṃ gadamuktabhāram 26 lubdhaḥ krūraḥ śaṭhajaṭharako madyapaścālasaścādhīro bhīrurvikalahṛdayo hīnakarmārthamandaḥ | śāstrajñātopyaviditagadajñānapākhaṇḍakhaṇḍovarjyo vaidyaḥ prabalamatibhirbhūmipairvā sudūrāt 27 vaidyaśāstrapaṭhanavidhiḥ adbhutaṃ cāpyaśaṅkañca nātyuccaṃ nīcameva ca yaḥ paṭhecchāstramitthañca śāstrāptistasya dṛśyate 28 carvaṇaṃ gilanaṃ cāpi kampitaṃ śvasitaṃ tathā nococcaṃ caiva gambhīraṃ varjayetpāṭhakena tu 29 anadhyāyena śāstrasya notsave yajñakarmasu jātake sūtake cātha paṭhanaṃ na vidhīyate 30 caturdaśyaṣṭamīdarśapratipatpūrṇimāstathā varjyāḥ pañca imāḥ pāṭhe munibhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ 31 akāle durdine garje digdāhe bhūmikampane śāstrapāṭhastathā varjyo grahaṇe candrasūryyayoḥ 32 dvādaśaite anadhyāyāḥ proktāḥ śṛṇuṣva putraka gurupīḍāsamutpanne nṛpe saṃpīḍite'thavā 33 āhave jīvasampāte pradoṣe vā'thavā punaḥ rāṣṭrapīḍāsamutpanne na kuryācchāstrapāṭhanam 34 etaistu paṭhitaṃ śāstraṃ na svārthe siddhisādhakam na śreyase na māṅgalye nopakāre sukhāvahama 35 evaṃ jñātvā paṭhati nipuṇo vaidyavidyānidhānaṃ śreyastasya pratidinamasau vāñchitārthaṃ prapadyet | kīrtiḥ saukhyaṃ bhavati nitarāṃ tasya lokapraśaṃsā pūjyo rājñāṃ satatamapi vai jāyate svārthasiddhiḥ 36 iti ātreyabhāṣite hārītottare vaidyaguṇadoṣaśāstrapaṭhanavidhirnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ 1 dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ cikitsāsaṃgraha ātreya uvāca athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śāstrasyāsya samuccayam āyurvedasamutpattiṃ sarvaśāstrārthasaṃgraham 1 aṣṭau cātra cikitsāśca tiṣṭhanti bhiṣajāṃ vara tā vakṣyāmi samāsena cikitsāśca pṛthakpṛthak 2 saṃgrahasya pravakṣyāmi prathamaṃ cānnapānakam ariṣṭaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ syāttṛtīyaṃ ca cikitsitam 3 kalpaṃ caturthakaṃ proktaṃ sūtrasthānantu pañcamam ṣaṣṭhaṃ cātra śarīraṃ syādityāyurvedakārakāḥ 4 śalyaśālākyakāyāśca tathā bālacikitsitam agadaṃ viṣatantrañca bhūtavidyā rasāyanam vājīkaraṇameveti cikitsā cāṣṭadhā smṛtā 5 vaidyāgameṣu sarveṣu proktaṃ śreṣṭhamidaṃ mahat tathā cāṣṭau cikitsāyāṃ vadanti vedavijjanāḥ 6 yantraśastrāgnikṣārāṇāmauṣadhaṃ pathyameva ca svedanaṃ mardanaṃ caiva kathitānyupakāriṇām 7 etairvaidyakaśāstrasya sāro bhavati sarvataḥ 8 śalyatantram yantraśāstrārthabandhaistu yena codhriyate bhiṣak tacca śalyoddharaṇakaṃ procyate vaidyakāgame nārācavālavallībhirbhallaiḥ kuntaiśca tomaraiḥ 9 śilāgnibhinnagātrasya tatra sāryyādiśalyakam 10 tatpratīkārakaraṇaṃ tacca śalyacikitsitam tathā bāṇasamuddiṣṭatṛṇapāṃśukṛmīkacam raktavastu tathā peśī pūyaṃ śeṣāntare'pi yat 11 tacchalyamiti jānīyālloṣṭakāṣṭhavibhinnakam 12 śālākyam śirorogā netrarogāḥ karṇarogā viśeṣataḥ bhrūkaṇṭhaśaṃkhamanyāsu ye rogāḥ sambhavanti hi 13 teṣāṃ pratīkārakarma nāsāvartyañjanāni ca abhyaṅgaṃ mukhagaṇḍūṣakriyā śālākyanāmikā 14 iti śālākyaṃ nāma kāyacikitsā kaṣāyacūrṇaguṭikā pañcānāṃ śodhanāni ca koṣṭhāmayānāṃ śamanīkriyā kāyacikitsitam 15 gudāmayaṃ bastirujaṃ śamanaṃ bastirūhakam āsthāpanānuvāsantu agadaṃ nāma eva ca 16 bālacikitsā garbhopakramavijñānaṃ sūtikopakramastathā bālānāṃ rogaśamanaṃ kriyā bālacikitsitam 17 viṣatantraṃ nāma sarpavṛścikalūtānāṃ viṣopaśamanī tu yā sā kriyā viṣatantrañca nāma proktā manīṣibhiḥ 18 bhūtavidyānāma grahabhūtapiśācāśca śākinīḍākinīgrahāḥ eteṣāṃ nigrahaḥ samyagbhūtavidyā nigadyate 19 vājīkaraṇam kṣīṇānāṃ cālpavīryāṇāṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavarddhanam tarpaṇaṃ samadhātūnāṃ vājīkaraṇamucyate 20 rasāyanatantram dehasyendriyadantānāṃ dṛḍhīkaraṇameva ca valīpalitakhālityavarjane'pi ca yā kriyā 21 pūrvaṃ vaidyapraṇītaṃ hi tadrasāyanamucyate 22 upāṅgacikitsā chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ tathā bhagnaṃ kṣataṃ piccitameva ca teṣāṃ dagdhapratīkāraḥ proktaścopāṅgasaṃjñakaḥ 23 iti vaidyakasarvasvaṃ cikitsāgamabhūṣaṇam paṭhitvā tu sudhīḥ samyak prāpsyate siddhisaṅgamam 24 iti vaidyakasarvasve cikitsāsaṃgraho nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ 2 tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ vaidyaśikṣāvidhānam atha vakṣyāmi rogāṇāmupacārakramaṃ tathā jānāti yo budhaḥ samyak pūjyate nṛpasattamaiḥ 1 jñātvā rogasamutpattiṃ rogāṇāmapyupakramam jñātvā pratikriyāṃ vaidyaḥ pratikuryādyathocitām 2 deśaṃ kālaṃ vayo vahniṃ sātmyaprakṛtibheṣajam dehaṃ satvaṃ balaṃ vyādherdṛṣṭvā karma samācaret 3 dharmārthakāmalābhaḥ syāt samyagāturasevanāt yadā nācaratastasya vināśaścātmanastadā 4 vyādhestattvaparijñānaṃ vedanāyāśca nigrahaḥ etadvaidyasya vaidyatvaṃ na vaidyaḥ prabhurāyuṣaḥ 5 dvividhopakramaścaiva śamanaḥ kopano rujām tathaiva jñātvā vibudhaḥ kriyāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ 6 vaidyo'pi dvividho jñeyo vikāreṅgitarogayoḥ upacārāpacārajño dvividhaḥ procyate bhiṣak 7 upacāreṇa śamanamapacāreṇa kopanam evaṃ vijñāya sadvaidyaḥ kuryyāt saṃśamanakriyām 8 sādhyo'sādhyaśca yāpyaśca kṛcchrasādhyastathaiva ca vyādhiścaturvidhaḥ proktaḥ sadvaidyaiḥ śāstrakovidaiḥ 9 upacāreṇa sādhyā ye rogā gacchanti yāpyatām yāpyāstvasādhyatāṃ yānti sādhyakaṣṭena putraka 10 sambhavanti mahārogāḥ kaṣṭasādhyā mriyanti vai evaṃ caturvidho vyādhirjñātvā karma samācaret 11 upacārakṛtā doṣāḥ kṛcchrāste yānti yāpyatām yāpyāḥ sādhyatvamāyānti kaṣṭasādhyaṃ bhaveddhruvam 12 sukhasādhyaḥ sukhī śīghraṃ syāt sudhībhirupakramaiḥ sādhyāsādhyaparijñānaṃ jñātvopakramaṇaṃ tathā 13 sādhyaṃ gate yadā roge doṣaśeṣaṃ na dhārayet doṣaśeṣe'pi kaṣṭaṃ syāttasmādyatnānnikṛntayet 14 yathā hi kāladuṣṭaḥ syāt yathā sūkṣmo'gnitaḥ kaṇaḥ svalpastadvat kriyāprāpto gado ghorataro bhavet 15 tathā doṣasya śeṣe tu śamanaṃ yāti cālpaśaḥ daivādyadduṣṭatāṃ yāti yathāgniḥ kupito bhṛśam 16 yathā kāṣṭhacayaṃ dūrāt prāpya ghorataro'gnikaḥ tathāpathyasya saṃyogādbhavedghorataro gadaḥ 17 kaṣāyaiśca phalaiścūrṇaiḥ piṇḍalehānuvāsanaiḥ sarvāḥ kriyā bhṛśaṃ vyarthā na śamaṃ yāti cāmayaḥ 18 evaṃ jñātvā sadā vaidye rogaśāntikakāraṇam karttavyamatiyogena yena rogaḥ praśāmyati 19 jñātvā doṣabalaṃ dhīmān laṅghanāni samācaret doṣe sati na doṣāya laṅghanāni bahūnyapi 20 pacetprathamamāhāraṃ doṣānāhārasaṃkṣaye doṣakṣaye'nalo dhātūn prāṇān dhātukṣaye sati 21 jñātvā balābalaṃ vyādheḥ sāmannirāmameva ca tadā sāme pācanaṃ syānnirāme pathyasaṃkramaḥ 22 sāmaṃ nirāmaṃ sukhasādhyameva samyag rujaśca parilakṣya rujo vināśam etadbhavet sakalavaidyakaśāstrasāraṃ naivāyuṣaśca baladānakaro hi vaidyaḥ 23 no vaidyo manujasya saukhyamathavā duḥkhañca dātuṃ kṣamo jantoḥ karmavipāka eva bhuvane saukhyāya duḥkhāya ca | tasmānmānavaduḥkhakāraṇarujāṃ nāśasya cātra kṣamo vaidyo buddhinidhānadhāma caturo nāmnaiva vaidyo'paraḥ 24 samyak rujāṃ parijñānaṃ jñātvā doṣavinigraham pratyākhyeyañca yaḥ sādhyaṃ jānāti sa bhavedbhiṣak 25 tapasvī ca brāhmaṇaśca striyo vā bālakastathā dīno vā durbalo vāpi prājño vā paṇḍitastathā 26 mahātmā śrotriyaḥ sādhuranātho bandhuvarjitaḥ etān vyādhivinigrastān pratikuryādviśeṣataḥ 27 rājā ca sudhanī caiva maṇḍalīko balādhipaḥ upacāryo'rthasiddhiḥ syādvittaṃ grāhyaṃ bhayaṃ na ca 28 madhyamā vaṇijāṃ pattiḥ purodhā brāhmaṇādayaḥ bhaṭṭo vā gaṇikāgaṇyaścikitsyāstu viśeṣataḥ rogagrasteṣu caiteṣu cikitsā kīrttikāriṇī 29 vyādhaścaurastathā mleccho vahnido matsyabandhakaḥ 30 bahudveṣo grāmakūṭo bandhakī māṃsavikrayī eteṣāṃ vyādhigrastānāṃ naiva kuryāt pratikriyām 31 etebhyaḥ svārthasiddhirnopakāro hitamaṅgalam teṣāṃ jīvāptasaṃjāto vaidyo bhavati doṣabhāk 32 evaṃ jñātvā tu sadvaidyaḥ kuryādatha pratikriyām dharmārthakāmasampattiḥ kīrtirloke pravarttate 33 iti bahuvidhiyukto vaidyavidyāvicāraḥ kṣaṇamapi hṛdaye yo dhāraṇaṃ saṃkaroti | sa bhavati gadasaṃghasyātha vidhvaṃsaśakto vimalaviditakīrttiḥ pūjyamāno narendraiḥ 34 iti ātreyabhāṣite hārītottare vaidyaśikṣāvidhāno nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ 3 caturtho'dhyāyaḥ atha deśakālabalābalam idānīṃ sampravakṣyāmi deśakālabalābalam sātmyaṃ prakṛtidehañca tathāgnīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam 1 deśastu trividho jñeyo hyanūpo jāṅgalastathā sādhāraṇo viśeṣeṇa jñātavyāste manīṣibhiḥ 2 bahutaraśubhanadyaścārupānīyapuṣṭāḥ sarasasaraupetā śādvalāsāra bhūmiḥ haritakuśajalānāṃ śālikedāraramyādinakarakaradīptiṃ vāñchate yatra lokaḥ 3 gurumadhurarasāḍhyā bhāti cekṣuḥ sadārdrā vividhajanitavarṇāḥ śāligodhūmayūṣāḥ madhurarasavibhuktyā mānavānāṃ prakopī bhavati kaphasamīraḥ syāttadānūpadeśaḥ 4 kharaparuṣaviśālāḥ parvatāḥ kaṇṭakīrṇā diśi diśi mṛgatṛṣṇā bhūruhāḥ śīrṇaparṇāḥ | atikhararaviraśmīpāṃśusampūrṇabhūmiḥ sarasi rasavihīnā kūpakāmbhaḥprakarṣaḥ 5 tadanu virasasasyāhāriṇo gomahiṣyaḥ prabhavati rasamāṃse rūkṣabhāvaśca samyak punarapi himavāhaṃ śāliśasyaṃ na cekṣurbhavati rudhirapittaṃ kopamāśu hyupaiti 6 ubhayaguṇaśataṃ vā nātirūkṣaṃ na snigdhaṃ na ca kharabahulaṃ ceccābhitaḥ kaṇṭakāḍhyam bhavati ca jalakīrṇaṃ nātiśītaṃ na coṣṇaṃ samaprakṛtisametaṃ viddhi sādhāraṇaṃ ca 7 kālastu trividho jñeyo'tīto'nāgata eva ca varttamānastṛtīyastu vakṣyāmi śṛṇu lakṣaṇam 8 kālaḥ kālayate lokaṃ kālaḥ kālayate jagat kālaḥ kālayate viśvaṃ tena kālo vidhīyate 9 kālasya vaśagāḥ sarvaṃ devarṣisiddhakinnarāḥ kālo hi bhagavān devaḥ sa sākṣātparameśvaraḥ 10 sarpapālanasaṃharttā sa kālaḥ sarvataḥ samaḥ kālena kālyate viśvaṃ tena kālo vidhīyate 11 yenotpattiśca jāyeta yena vai kalpate kalā sattvavāṃstu bhavetkālo jagadutpattikārakaḥ 12 yaḥ karmāṇi prapaśyeta prakarṣaṃ varttamānake so'pi pravarttako jñeyaḥ kālaḥsyātpratikālakaḥ 13 yena mṛtyuvaśaṃ yāti kṛtaṃ yena layaṃ vrajet saṃharttā so'pi vijñeyaḥ kālaḥ syātkalanāparaḥ 14 kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ kālaḥ svapiti jāgartti kālo hi duratikramaḥ 15 kāle devā vinaśyanti kāle cāsurapannagāḥ narendrāḥ sarvajīvāśca kāle sarvaṃ vinaśyati 16 trikālāt parato jñeya āganturgataceṣṭakaḥ sūkṣmo'pi sarvagaḥ sarvairvyaktāvyaktataraḥ śubhaḥ 17 tathā varṣāhimoṣṇākhyāstrayaḥ kālā ime matāḥ tathā trayo'nye'pi jñeyā udayamadhyāstameva ca 18 varṣā śaracca hemantaḥ śiśiraśca vasantakaḥ grīṣmo'tikramato jñeya evaṃ ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ 19 pṛthakpṛthak pravakṣyāmi ravergativiśeṣaṇaiḥ prakopaṃ śamanaṃ jñātvā ayane dve smṛte budhaiḥ 20 dakṣiṇāyanamekaṃ syāt dvitīyaṃ cottarāyaṇam varṣā śaracca hemanto dakṣiṇāyanamadhyagāḥ 21 śiśiraśca vasantaśca grīṣmaḥ syāduttarāyaṇe yāmye gatiryadā bhānostadā cāndraguṇā mahī 22 vāri śītalasambhūtaṃ śītaṃ tatra prajāyate balino madhurāstiktāḥ kaṣāyāstu viśeṣataḥ 23 jīvānāṃ sātmyamatulamoṣadhīnāṃ ca vīryatā ārdratvaṃ bhūdharāṇāñca diśaścāpyatiśītalāḥ 24 sakledā pṛthivī sarvā tasmādārdrā saphenilā kathaṃ cikitsayet pittaṃ kopaṃ yāti vilīyate 25 tasmādanuviparyāsādupacāreṇa śāmyati yadodīcyāṃ gatirbhānostadā sūryyo jalādhipaḥ 26 tasmāduṣṇaguṇāstīvrāḥ sambhavanti vidāhinaḥ kharasūryāṃśujālaistu śuṣyate vanakānanam 27 saṃśuṣkā medinī sarvādiśaḥ pānādinorasāḥ balino'mlakaṭukṣārāḥ sambhavanti vidāhinaḥ 28 tasmāt saṃkupyate pittaṃ raktena saha mūrcchitam oṣadhirasaḥ saṃśuṣko gojātīnāṃ payāṃsi ca 29 alpaṃ balaṃ ca jantūnāṃ kathañcitkaphasambhavaḥ dṛśyate ca vasante ca svayameva śamaṃ vrajet 30 evaṃ jñātvā sudhīḥ samyakkuryātsarvaṃ pratikriyām 31 saghanavāridavārisamākulā akhilavatpravarodakapūritāḥ samadavātakarā vidiśo diśaḥ pramuditakrimikīṭabhṛtā mahī 32 nīlasasyaharitojjvalā mahī kulyakā salilasaṃplutā natā indragopakavirājitā varā paṅkabhūṣaṇabibhūṣitā dharā 33 udbhinnacūtāṃkuro bhūdharaḥ syādreje vanaṃ vā
